question: Should omitted Active Memory `config.agents` mean no targets, implicit `main` only, or every configured agent?
rationale: Each choice changes released upgrade behavior and which agent sessions become eligible for memory recall, so permanent semantics require feature-owner intent rather than reviewer inference.

options.title: Default omission to main
options.body: Fix the linked single-agent inconsistency while keeping multi-agent activation explicit and preserving `agents: []` as no targets.

options.title: Adopt all configured agents
options.body: Accept this PR's broader default with explicit owner approval and fresh-install plus upgrade proof across multiple agents.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Retain the released no-target omission behavior and require operators to list every targeted agent.

recommendation.title: Default omission to main
recommendation.body: Fix the linked single-agent inconsistency while keeping multi-agent activation explicit and preserving `agents: []` as no targets.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature and its original targeting/runtime contract appear to originate in Takhoffman's merged Active Memory work.
